notes: Direct fetch worked throughout, no blocking encountered. Category tree from mega-nav (168 links dumped via probe.py nav). All qtys verified via the site's own 'Currently displaying: 1 - N of N results' listing header (Nuxt/D3R headless storefront, not Shopify). Rule 0 applied: kept Bathroom Lighting (15, lighting?bathroom_safe=yes) and Bathroom Mirrors (17) despite the room word, and documented their overlap with the separate Bathroom mega-nav column (same URLs, cross-listed by both Lighting and Bathroom menus - counted once each here). 'Mirrors' (/mirrors, 39) is an exact parent rollup of Wall & Vanity Mirrors (28) + Floor Mirrors (11) = 39, so emitted as a parent grouping row over its two children rather than a third leaf. 'Art' (/art, 60) is likewise an exact rollup of Original Artwork (41) + Printed Editions (19) = 60, emitted as a parent; the style facets under Art (Abstract/Minimalist/Maximalist/Landscape/Geometric/Figurative) are theme re-cuts of the same 60 items, not separate branches, so dropped. Excluded as facet/material re-cuts (product-ID overlap checked): Flush Ceiling Lights (11) - all 11 product handles are a strict subset of Ceiling Lights (46), a fixture-type facet; Crystal Glassware (20) - 15 of 21 sampled handles already appear in Glassware (38), a material facet. Excluded Barware (17, dining/barware) - product titles are bottle openers, ice buckets, cocktail shakers, coasters and decanters (bar tools), not drinking glasses; the actual whisky/rocks/wine/coupe glasses live under Glassware and are already counted there. Excluded Cutlery Sets (flatware, out of scope), Bathroom Vanities (furniture), Bathroom Accessories & Hardware (13 - bins, toilet brushes, toilet-roll holders, towel racks: bathroom hardware; the one mirror/light/vanity product tile it also shows is cross-tagged and already counted in its own category), Bath & Pool Towels / Robes & Sleepwear (textiles), Stationery, Books & Records (11 - books, vinyl records, journals, laptop sleeves: not home decor in primary purpose). Excluded entirely: Home Fragrance (all scented candles/diffusers/incense), Furniture, Rugs & Textiles, Outdoor Seating/Tables/Sunloungers/Parasols (furniture; outdoor-accessories page checked - parasols, fire pit, lilos, table covers, no decor), Gifting, Sale/Outlet/New Arrivals nav rows. No standalone Clocks category exists on this site.
